summary: The content defines a class named LoginNewProgram that is responsible for retrieving program details from a database and storing them in a list of ProgramItem objects.
purpose: To manage the login process for new programs in the HSPnet system by retrieving and organizing program information.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Concatenated string of the long and short names of the program.

workflows.name: Data Retrieval Workflow
steps: Initialize a new LoginNewProgram object with an HSPnetSession.
Invoke the FillList method to populate program data.
Use the HSPnetSession to call the procedure LoginWelcomeNewHSPnetPrograms.
Iterate over the SqlDataReader to create ProgramItem objects.
Add each ProgramItem to the internal Data list.

business_rules: Program names are combined from long and short names separated by a comma.
conditions: SqlDataReader must not be null to proceed with data reading.
system_behavior: Retrieves data from the database using the stored procedure LoginWelcomeNewHSPnetPrograms.
Closes the SqlDataReader after data has been read.
dependencies: HSPnetSession must be provided to the constructor of LoginNewProgram.
exceptions: Handles the case where SqlDataReader is null by not attempting to read.
